Our Project Preview

FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

1- What’s included in the estimate?

Our estimates include detailed material quantity takeoffs, labor and material costs (based on current market rates), and a clear breakdown by trade or CSI division. You’ll receive a well-organized spreadsheet or PDF report that can be used for bidding, budgeting, or construction planning.

2- How do I send you my plans?

You can email your drawings in PDF format to Alex@constructestimates.com. If your plans are hosted on platforms like Dropbox, Google Drive, or a builder’s portal, just send us the link. We’ll confirm receipt and get started promptly.

3- Do you estimate permit sets or remodels?

Yes! We provide estimates for a variety of project types including permit sets, remodels, new builds, and tenant improvements. Whether it’s a residential renovation or a commercial upgrade, we tailor the estimate to fit your scope and design stage.

4- What’s your accuracy or guarantee?

Our estimates are typically accurate within a 1–5% range, depending on the clarity and completeness of the plans. We use up-to-date pricing and follow industry-standard measurement practices. While we don’t offer fixed-price guarantees, we stand behind the quality and consistency of our work.

5- Is the 50% credit a discount or refund?

The 50% credit is applied as a discount on your first full project estimate. It’s our way of welcoming new clients and giving you a risk-free opportunity to experience the value of our service.

Building Estimator Melbourne

Home

Building & Construction Estimators In Melbourne

Melbourne’s Cost-Estimation Experts: Where Vision Meets Precision for Your Construction Building Projects with Substantial Savings. Let’s Build Your Dream with Confidence!

Request Accurate Estimate Now & Save 30%

Melbourne Building Cost Estimator

Are you ready to revolutionise your construction and building projects and unlock remarkable savings? Whether you’re a seasoned builder, developer, or homeowner, you need a meticulously calculated building cost estimation report and the best quantity surveys possible. Construct Estimates is your trusted estimation partner to make your construction endeavours in Melbourne more cost-effective, efficient, and transparent.

Our track record speaks volumes.

  • Over 8,000 Projects Completed
  • Ensure up to 100% Accuracy
  • 25+ Highly Qualified Construction Estimators
  • Cost Savings up to 30%
View Sample Estimates Here!

Your Construction Estimating Trusted Partner In Melbourne

Expertise Beyond Measure

Our team boasts 10 years of industry experience, guaranteeing unparalleled accuracy in cost estimates and quantity takeoffs for residential, commercial, and industrial projects. We don't just estimate; we provide expert guidance with the wisdom and insights from an established track record of excellence.

Versatility Across All Projects

Whether it's a simple renovation, a new home build, a commercial or industrial project, or even a high-rise residential development, No matter the scope, we're equipped to handle and serve your unique needs.

Transparent Costing

Unlike others who rely on cost guides, we dive deeper to provide you with concrete data and rates in Melbourne. This transparency empowers you to make secure budget decisions and eliminates uncertainties.

ROI-Driven Approach

Our focus is on providing you with a return on investment (ROI) on the reports you receive. Construct Estimates can save up to 30% on your construction costs. That could translate to incredible savings in your pocket, making your projects successful and highly profitable.

Key Features You will Get

When you choose Construct Estimates, you’re partnering with a construction estimating service that stands out in the industry. Here are the key features that distinguish us:

Timely Delivery (24 - 48 Hrs)

Construction Estimates understand the importance of deadlines. Our quick and efficient delivery ensures your project stays on track.

Competitive Rates

We keep our pricing competitive, making our services accessible to a wide range of clients.

Accurate Database (Zip-code Based)

Our estimators rely on an accurate construction cost database, ensuring our estimates are ZIP code-based and precise.

Certified Construction Estimators

Our team consists of certified building estimators who bring professionalism and expertise to every project.

24/7 Customer Support

Need assistance? We’re here for you around the clock, ready to address your queries via chat or email.

Marked-Up Plans

Our building estimates come with marked-up drawing plans, providing you with a comprehensive understanding of the project.

Confidentiality

We prioritize client confidentiality, ensuring your project details are secure.

Ease of Understanding

Our estimates are designed to be easy to understand, making the process smooth and transparent.

Why Do You Need a Building Estimator in Melbourne?

Do you know how much your next building project in Melbourne will cost? Construct Estimates is a Australian-based estimating services company that specialises in providing you with the accurate building cost estimates you need. Here’s why engaging our construction building estimator is essential:

  • Budget Assurance: We ensure your proposed design aligns perfectly with your construction cost budget.
  • Value Cost Engineering: When required, we perform value cost engineering to optimise your budget.
  • Comparing Quotes: Use our cost estimate to compare building and subcontractor quotes effectively.
  • Progress and Variations: Engage our construction cost estimator to manage progress claims and variations, preventing cost blowouts.

How We Help You?

Over the years, many clients have fallen victim to overpriced builders and inaccurate costings, leading to financial strain. Our focus is on providing you with a return on investment (ROI) on the reports you receive. We’ll spend time with you to identify opportunities to save and maximise your budget.

Powered by Experience

With more than 10 years of experience in the construction industry, we proudly serve leading builders, architects, and developers in Melbourne, Sydney, and across Australia. Homeowners directly trust Construct Estimates with their building projects. We pride ourselves on being hands-on, affordable, and eager to share insights on how you can bring your building project to life – with complete control, on time, and within budget.

Why You Need a Building Cost Estimate?

Can you afford uncertainty, financial loss, project delays, or financial exposure in your construction project? Our precise building cost estimates provide the peace of mind to complete your project within budget on time and identify opportunities to save thousands of dollars.

  • Uncertainty: Building and labour costs have surged in recent years. We give you confidence that your project will stay on budget.
  • Financial Loss: With some materials costing up to four times more than before, we help you uncover cost-saving opportunities.
  • Project Delays: Transparent cost plans and documentation minimise costly delays.
  • Financial Exposure: Incorrect cost plans may affect your construction loan and finance capacity. We minimise this risk with highly accurate cost reports based on the latest market rates.

Our Melbourne Building Estimating Services

Construct Estimates pride herself on being the cornerstone of cost accuracy and project success in Melbourne. Our comprehensive services include:

  • New Construction Building Cost Estimate Reports
  • Extension and Renovation Cost Estimate Reports
  • Independent Building Contract Price Evaluations
  • Material and Trade Price Cost Evaluations
  • Building Consultancy
  • Quantity Surveying, Monitoring, and Reporting
  • Building Cost Disputes and Reporting
  • Contract Administration
  • Feasibility Studies for Builders and Developers
  • Cost Planning by Project Phase: Concept, Design, Detailed & Tender
  • Building Progress Claim Reports and Variation Assessments

Get Ahead of the Competition with Unbeatable Offers!

Unlock 30% off your first estimate and Save up to 60% on monthly estimating expenses

Monthly Takeoff Package

Our Unique Approach Towards Construction Estimating in Melbourne

Unlike others, we don’t rely on typical cost guides. Our expertise in the Melbourne market allows us to tailor estimates based on the project’s geographical location. We believe that you are only as good as your rates. That’s why every construction cost estimate we produce is based on real, local data and specific project requirements.

Empowering the Concept Stage

We recommend engaging our services at the concept stage of your project. This ensures that your preliminary design aligns seamlessly with your budget requirements. Our in-depth knowledge of the Melbourne area allows us to estimate structural and foundation costs accurately.

Value Engineering for Budget Optimisation

If your project's costs exceed your budget, our construction estimators can perform a value engineering exercise similar to that performed by quantity surveyors in Melbourne. We study your construction costs holistically and recommend alternative materials and structures to reduce costs without compromising your project's scope.

Tailored Construction Estimations for Every Project in Melbourne

We understand that construction projects in Melbourne can vary significantly in scope and complexity. Whether you're an architect aiming to secure more projects, a builder looking to optimise returns, or a homeowner seeking to accurately cost your project to compare builder quotes, we've got you covered. Construct Estimates offers a range of estimation options suited to your unique requirements.

For Melbourne Architects and Designers

Early on in the project, it's crucial to determine if your proposed designs align with your client's budget. Our services provide the cost estimates you need to make informed decisions, ensuring you can consistently deliver your projects on time and within budget.

For Melbourne Builders

If you're a Melbourne-based builder, we understand that pricing projects can be a time-consuming process. Let us take the burden off your shoulders. Our comprehensive costing service delivers accurate estimates and quantity surveys for various project types. Our cost plans are easy to review, transparent, and can be delivered within 24 hours. Win more projects and stay ahead with Construct Estimates.

Our Building Estimation Process

Step 1: Efficient Planning

We engage in comprehensive discussions with your construction management team to plan and assign tasks efficiently.

Step 2: Quantity Estimation

Our expert quantity estimators employ the latest takeoff software, such as Bluebeam, Planswift, and On Screen takeoff, to evaluate quantity takeoff accurately.

Step 3: Pricing Evaluation

We assess pricing, incorporating material costs from procurement suppliers, costing catalogs, and online databases like RSMeans.

Step 4: Additional Considerations

We account for additional factors, including material logistics, inflation, and site constraints, to provide a holistic estimate.

Step 5: Quality Control

Our team maintains stringent quality control throughout the process. Senior cost managers audit all estimations, ensuring adherence to certified rules and standards.

We take pride in offering a professional and diverse platform, catering to the unique needs of our clients across Australia. Our mission is to empower construction stakeholders with accurate and comprehensive construction estimation services, supported by an experienced team of estimators ready to serve you.

Schedule A Call

We Help

  • Architects & Designers: Ensure your proposed designs align with your clients’ budgets.
  • Builders: Win more projects and stay updated with market rates.
  • Homeowners: Avoid overpriced builders and get the best value for your money.
  • Developers: Partner with us to boost your profitability.
  • Cost Estimate Outsourcing: For builders, developers, and architects looking to streamline their operations, we offer cost-estimating outsourcing solutions. Save time, reduce costs, and mitigate risks by entrusting your cost estimates to our experts.

Construct Estimates is your trusted partner across the building and construction industries. With our unwavering commitment to precision, integrity, and client satisfaction, we’ve consistently exceeded expectations for years.

Quantity Surveys for Comprehensive Planning

Our quantity surveyors in Sydney are pivotal in helping you plan your project effectively. We provide realistic cost estimates from the conceptual stages to the final product. During the planning phase, we offer advice on the project’s feasibility and tips for maintaining cost-effectiveness. Our quantity surveyors also produce tax depreciation reports, staying well-versed in all local codes, from Perth to the Gold Coast. We take a meticulous approach, comparing costs for projects similar to yours to scrutinise and fine-tune your plan.

Construct Estimates specialises in conceptual advising, cost estimating, and quantity surveying. We’ll help you plan your work and ensure that you carry out your plan. Our services are designed to offer you a complete package, ensuring success at every project stage. We’re your trusted partner throughout your construction journey, from field audits and software consultations to training, material lists, quantity surveys, and support services.

Service Areas Across Australia

We extend our top-notch estimating services to various regions throughout Australia. Experience our exceptional construciton and building estimators in these dynamic regions, where precision, reliability, and attention to detail are the cornerstones of our approach. We ensure that construction stakeholders across Australia receive the utmost precision and professionalism in their project estimates.

Lumber Takeoff Services to Streamline Your Construction Projects

Are you searching for a reliable and professional hub for Lumber Takeoff Services? Construct Estimates is your go-to destination for accurate and efficient lumber estimation. Act Now & Get 30% Off

Solving Lumber Takeoff and Estimating Challenges for Various Clients

Construct Estimates understand the unique challenges that lumber contractors, framers, and vendors face. Whether you’re a general contractor, developer, millwork contractor, or carpenter, our expertise caters to a wide range of clients in the construction industry.

Our dedicated team of experienced lumber estimators has worked with numerous contractors across the Australia and USA, providing them with reliable and accurate lumber takeoffs. We specialize in quantifying all aspects of wood and plastic composites, ensuring that your estimates encompass the complete scope of the project. Our expertise allows you to win bids, negotiate favorable terms with suppliers, and improve your overall profitability.

Enabling General Contractors and Builders

General contractors and builders greatly benefit from our lumber takeoffs. Our detailed estimates, including timber or lumber quantities, labor costs, transportation expenses, and more, empower you to negotiate effectively with suppliers and subcontractors. By leveraging our accurate lumber cut lists, you can optimize material usage and minimize waste, resulting in cost savings and a more sustainable approach. Our expertise in framing material estimation ensures that you can easily manage your busy schedule while reducing your workload.

Trusted by Architects, Designers, and Retailers

Do you know Why Architects, designers, lumber retailers, and suppliers rely on our lumber takeoff estimating services? Our exact estimates provide them with the necessary information to advise their customers on the right material quantities, boosting sales and fostering long-term business relationships. Additionally, our accurate lumber cut lists facilitate smooth conversions from lineal foot to board foot, ensuring minimal waste and a more environmentally friendly approach. By outsourcing your lumber takeoffs to Construct Estimates, you gain access to expert wood framing estimators who adhere to international standards and provide reliable and accurate results.

What You Will Get In Our Lumber Takeoff Deliverables to Enhance Your Project

When you choose Construct Estimates for your lumber takeoff needs, you gain access to a wide range of deliverables designed to support and enhance your construction projects. Our comprehensive approach ensures that every aspect of your lumber takeoff is addressed, providing the necessary data and insights to make informed decisions. Our deliverables include:

Accurate Lumber Quantities and Costs

Our detailed lumber takeoffs provide precise quantities of timber or lumber required for your project. This includes structural and non-structural lumber components, such as framing panels, sill plates, wall studs, corner studs, and more. We consider your project's specific requirements, enabling you to plan effectively and allocate resources efficiently. Our estimates also incorporate labor costs, material costs, and transportation expenses, giving you a comprehensive understanding of the project's financial implications.

Lumber Cut Lists for Optimal Material Usage

Our lumber cut lists play a crucial role in optimizing material usage and minimizing waste. By providing detailed instructions on cutting lengths of lumber, we ensure that you make the most of each piece, reducing unnecessary expenses and contributing to a more sustainable construction process. Our accurate cut lists facilitate seamless conversions from lineal foot to board foot, enabling woodworkers to work efficiently and effectively.

Marked-up Up Drawing Plans and Bid Summaries

To support your bidding and project management processes, we provide marked-up drawing plans that visually represent the lumber requirements. These plans make it easier to communicate your project needs to stakeholders, suppliers, and subcontractors. Additionally, our bid summaries include a breakdown of total material, labor, and equipment costs, profit percentages, overheads, insurance, logistics, permits, taxes, and other relevant expenses. With our comprehensive bid summaries, you can make informed decisions and accurately assess the financial aspects of your project.

Expert Consultation and Review

At Construct Estimates, we go beyond delivering lumber estimates by offering expert consultation and review services. Our experienced wood estimators meticulously review your plans, material specifications, and project requirements to ensure that all inclusions and exclusions are accounted for. We follow the guidelines of respected industry associations such as the American Association of Cost Engineers (AACE) and the Australian Institute of Quantity Surveyors (AIQS), guaranteeing reliable and accurate results.

Experience the Difference with Construct Estimates

When you partner with us for your lumber takeoff and estimating needs, you gain access to comprehensive services tailored to your specific requirements. Our accurate estimates, detailed deliverables, and experienced team of estimators ensure that your construction projects are streamlined and successful.

Contact us today at (048) 862-0354 for AUS and (737) 273-3314 for USA or upload your plans to benefit from our expertise and take advantage of our limited-time 30% discount. Trust Construct Estimates for reliable and precise lumber takeoff and estimating services that propel your projects forward.

Submit Plans & Get 30 Off

Range Of Materials We Quantify in Our Lumber Takeoffs

We cover a diverse range of materials. Our expert estimators are well-versed in quantifying various wood and plastic composites and millwork, ensuring that every aspect of your project is accurately accounted for. The materials we quantify in our lumber takeoffs include, but are not limited to:

1. Millwork

From cabinets and countertops to wood stairs and railing, our lumber takeoffs encompass all aspects of millwork. We provide precise estimates for millwork components, enabling you to plan and execute your projects confidently.

2. Framing

Framing is a crucial part of any construction project, and our expertise extends to quantifying all framing-related materials. This includes wooden studs, structural and non-structural lumber, floor decking, roof decking, and more. Our detailed estimates empower you to manage your framing requirements efficiently.

3. Trim and Siding

Trim and siding play an essential role in enhancing the aesthetics and functionality of a building. We quantify materials such as standing and running trim, eaves, rakes, casework, and wood paneling, ensuring that your trim and siding needs are accurately assessed.

4. Structural Components

We also cover the quantification of structural components. This includes items like structural timber, wood trusses, floor joists, beams, and subfascia. We help you plan and execute structurally sound projects by providing accurate estimates for these materials.

Construct Estimates offers a diverse range of lumber estimating services to cater to the specific needs of your construction projects. Our expertise extends beyond traditional lumber takeoffs, ensuring we can provide valuable support throughout various stages of your project. Our range of lumber estimating services includes:

Our core service revolves around providing detailed and itemized lumber takeoffs and quantifying the materials required for your project. This includes everything from structural and non-structural lumber components to window and door casings, rough carpentry, decking, framing, trim, and more. With our expertise, you can optimize resource allocation, streamline your budgeting process, and make informed decisions.

Framing Takeoffs

Our cut lists provide detailed instructions on how to cut lengths of lumber, enabling you to maximize resource utilization and reduce unnecessary expenses. This way, you can ensure maximum efficiency in your woodworking projects.

 Ignite Your Projects - Unlock 30% Off!

Review of Project Specifications

We thoroughly review your project plans, material specifications, and other relevant documentation to understand the scope of work and project requirements.

Timely Delivery

Why Should You Outsource Your Lumber Estimates to Us?

Outsourcing your lumber estimates to Construct Estimates brings numerous benefits to your construction projects. Here’s why you should choose us as your trusted estimating partner:

Expertise and Accuracy

Our team of experienced lumber estimators deeply understands the construction industry. We adhere to respected associations like the American Association of Cost Engineers (AACE) and the Australian Institute of Quantity Surveyors (AIQS) standards. With our expertise and attention to detail, you can rely on accurate estimates that reflect the actual requirements of your projects.

Time and Cost Savings

Performing lumber takeoffs in-house can be time-consuming and resource-intensive. Outsourcing this task to us saves valuable time and resources that can be redirected to other critical aspects of your projects. Our efficient and timely delivery (24 to 48 hours) of estimates ensures that your projects stay on schedule and within budget.

Access to Specialized Tools and Resources

Construct Estimates utilizes the latest software and technologies to streamline the estimation process. By partnering with us, you gain access to these specialized tools and resources, allowing for faster and more accurate lumber takeoffs. Our connections with local vendors and up-to-date pricing databases ensure that your estimates reflect current market conditions.

Improved Bid-Hit Ratio

Our accurate and detailed estimates contribute to a higher bid-hit ratio. With our comprehensive bid summaries and marked-up drawing plans, you can present your proposals confidently, increasing your chances of winning bids and securing profitable projects.

How to Begin Your Lumber Takeoffs with Us

Submit Your Drawing Plans

You can easily upload your drawing plans in various formats, including PDF files, through our user-friendly platform, contact page, or email us at info@constructestimates.com. We value your convenience, so feel free to choose the method that works best for you. Don’t forget to provide us with essential information about your project scope and any specific details by filling out the form.

We Review The Plans

Our team will swiftly proceed to review the intricacies of your project. We understand that every client and project is unique, so we take the time to analyze factors such as project range, complexity, and involved trades. This ensures complete transparency and allows you to make informed decisions.

After reviewing your plans, we will promptly respond with a detailed quote containing essential information such as the invoice, turnaround time, and delivery date. If you find the quote acceptable, you can proceed to make the payment using your preferred method: a credit card, debit card, or PayPal.

You will receive the estimate in an Excel format using our template or customized to fit your specific requirements.

Fast and Accurate Construction Cost Estimates

We recommend engaging our services at the concept stage of your project. This ensures that your preliminary design aligns seamlessly with your budget requirements. Our in-depth knowledge of the Sydney area allows us to estimate structural and foundation costs accurately.

Our mission is to empower construction stakeholders with accurate and comprehensive construction estimating services, supported by an experienced team of estimators ready to serve you.

Get Started Today!

Our pricing is transparent and competitive, with estimates typically starting at $200, depending on the complexity of your project. We also offer monthly material takeoff packages that can save you up to 60% compared to hiring an in-house estimator.

We employ the latest takeoff software, such as Planswift and RS Means, combined with our extensive location-based pricing database, ensuring that our estimates are spot on. Every estimate undergoes rigorous double verification by our experienced construction estimators and senior quantity surveyors, followed by a final review by a senior project manager.

We maintain an extensive database that provides material and labor pricing specific to your location, including zip code constraints. Your local vendor and labor pricing can be seamlessly integrated into our estimates.

In addition to material estimates, we calculate labor costs and man hours, if required. This comprehensive approach empowers you to negotiate effectively with subcontractors and plan your project’s labor resources efficiently.

8. Efficiency with Digital Takeoffs

Utilizing advanced digital software such as Planswift, which allows the estimator to take off the quantities using a point-and-click approach. We offer digital takeoffs, eliminating the risk of manual calculation errors. This automation not only enhances accuracy but also streamlines the entire process, allowing for smoother project planning and execution.

9. Takeoff Format tailored to Your Needs

We provide estimates in various formats, including EXCEL spreadsheets, organized according to CSI MasterFormat, Uniformat, cost code, or construction phase. If you have custom requirements, we can adapt to meet them, ensuring that our services align perfectly with your needs.

Our estimates come complete with color-coded, marked-up plans. Each detail is accurately referenced on the drawings, ensuring that you have a clear visual representation of the estimated quantities and materials.

Commercial Estimating Services For Construction Projects

Empower Your Commercial Building construction Projects with Affordable Cost Estimation and Material Takeoff Solutions with Fast Turnaround Time.

Save Upto 30% On Estimating Expenses

Drive Your Construction Success in Estimating Commercial Projects

Construct Estimates, your trusted partner for accurate and efficient commercial estimating services. Our precise and detailed approach empowers Contractors, Subcontractors, Architects, and commercial zone developers to make informed decisions, win projects, and achieve their business goals.

Our experienced commercial building cost estimators employ cutting-edge technology and construction estimating software to provide you with meticulous material takeoffs and reliable cost estimates. Whether you’re embarking on new construction or planning renovations, our precise estimations lay the foundation for successful project execution. Our meticulous approach guarantees reliable and precise calculations, from conceptual estimates to detailed takeoffs.

Efficient and Professional Estimating Process

The time is a valuable resource in the competitive construction landscape, and our streamlined processes ensure you never miss a bid date again. Our licensed team of professional commercial construction estimators works diligently to deliver accurate estimates within your required timeframe, empowering you to stay ahead of the competition and seize profitable opportunities.
We specialize in delivering precise and detailed commercial takeoffs, ensuring accurate material and cost estimates for your commercial building projects.

View Sample Estimates Here!

Commercial Construction Estimating Services

For Commercial Contractors

Streamline your construction projects and enhance your bidding success rate with Construct Estimates’ professional commercial construction estimating services. With nationwide experience, we understand your challenges in balancing job site management and accurate project estimates. Our dedicated team of estimators will save you countless hours by preparing detailed and accurate bids, complete with material, labor, and equipment pricing based on zip code data.

1. Accurate Commercial Cost Estimates to Bid with Confidence

Preparing accurate bids within tight deadlines can be a daunting task. That’s why our team of experts leverages their industry knowledge and advanced construction cost databases to deliver the most precise and detailed commercial estimates. With our help, you can confidently submit competitive bids and maximize your chances of winning profitable projects.

2. Pre-Construction Final Estimates

Once your construction drawings are finalized, our commercial pre-construction estimates become invaluable in ensuring that your pricing aligns with market value. We provide comprehensive estimates that empower you to negotiate and compare pricing effectively. Our expertise and historical data enable us to identify areas where cost optimization is possible, allowing you to make informed decisions and avoid costly redesigns.

For Commercial Developers

Once your construction drawings are finalized, our commercial pre-construction estimates become invaluable in ensuring that your pricing aligns with market value. We provide comprehensive estimates that empower you to negotiate and compare pricing effectively. Our expertise and historical data enable us to identify areas where cost optimization is possible, allowing you to make informed decisions and avoid costly redesigns.

Preliminary Commercial Cost Estimates

With our extensive experience in estimating projects worth millions of dollars, we possess the expertise and historical data to prepare reliable preliminary cost estimates at the early stages of project planning. Our detailed pricing assessments provide valuable insights for making informed decisions and securing financing from lenders or investors.

Pre-Construction Final Commercial Estimates and Budgets

Once your construction drawings are finalized, our commercial pre-construction estimates serve as a crucial tool for ensuring that pricing aligns with market value. Our detailed estimates enable effective negotiation and comparison of bids and help identify any aspects of the project that require redesigning before it’s too late. Trust Construct Estimates to help you confidently navigate your project’s final stages.

For Commercial Architects & Designers

Lenders and investors generally require accurate cost estimates to ensure the success of larger projects. That’s where Construct Estimates collaborates closely with commercial architects and designers, providing detailed and realistic cost predictions to minimize the risk associated with investing in construction pursuits. Our accurate budgeting and value engineering help you achieve successful commercial projects.

Schematic Design-Phase Estimates

Our estimating team works closely with architects and designers to prepare accurate estimates during the design development’s early, middle, and final stages. By evaluating different design alternatives and their additional costs, we ensure that your project aligns with your client’s budget without compromising quality. This collaborative approach minimizes the need for costly revisions and helps you deliver exceptional spaces.

Budget Creation

During the transition to the Construction Administration phase, it is crucial to have realistic budgets in place. Construct Estimates assist commercial architects and designers in creating comprehensive budgets that hold contractors accountable. With our support, you can confidently manage costs and ensure the successful completion of your projects.

Value Engineering

We understand the delicate balance between creating remarkable commercial spaces and managing costs. Our value engineering expertise allows us to help you optimize project expenses without compromising the overall design integrity. Let us guide you through the value engineering process, ensuring your project achieves the perfect balance of excellence and cost efficiency.

For Commercial Design-Build Firms

Construct Estimates is dedicated to supporting design-build firms responsible for the design and construction phases of commercial projects. We understand your unique challenges in managing costs and ensuring project success under a single contract.

Early Stage Design-Build Estimates

Our design-build estimates play a critical role in helping project owners make informed decisions during the early stages, typically when designs are around 50% complete. By providing comprehensive cost assessments, including architectural, engineering, mechanical design, drafting service charges, subcontractor fees, labor costs, material costs, equipment costs, and more, we empower owners to make crucial decisions confidently.

Cost Management

Cost plan and management is vital to the success of any design-build project. Construct Estimates offers meticulous cost analysis and control throughout all project phases, ensuring expenses remain within budgetary constraints. Our expertise in cost estimation, value engineering, and procurement helps you optimize costs while maintaining project quality.

Change Order Management

Change orders are an inevitable part of the construction process. Our team excels in change order management, ensuring that any modifications to the original plans are accurately assessed and the cost implications are thoroughly evaluated. With our expertise, you can efficiently navigate change orders, minimizing disruptions and maintaining project profitability.

Project Scheduling

Efficient project scheduling is crucial to meeting project timelines and maximizing productivity. Construct Estimates provides comprehensive project scheduling services that align with your design-build approach. Our team works closely with you to develop realistic timelines, ensuring smooth coordination between design and construction activities and ultimately delivering projects on time.

Legal Claims Support

In the unfortunate event of legal disputes, our commercial construction estimating services extend to providing support for legal claims. We offer detailed documentation, cost analysis, and expert insights to help substantiate your claims and protect your interests. Trust us to provide accurate and reliable information to support your legal case.

Get Ahead of the Competition with Unbeatable Offers!

Unlock 30% off your first estimate and Save up to 60% on monthly estimating expenses

Monthly Takeoff Package

Why Choose Construct Estimates?

1. Experience and Expertise: Our professional estimators have extensive industry experience and expertise. We understand the unique challenges commercial contractors, subcontractors, and developers face, enabling us to deliver comprehensive budget estimates tailored to your specific needs. We provide reliable estimates to support your project planning and resource allocation 

2. Wide Coverage Across Australia and USA: With our services available throughout the USA and Australia, including prominent locations like New York City, and Sydney, we can support your projects nationwide. Our estimators are well-versed in local construction factors, ensuring accuracy and relevance for projects across different regions.

3. Precision and Detail-Oriented Approach: Construct Estimates is committed to providing precise and detailed estimations. Our construction takeoffs, conceptual estimates, and hard bid estimates give you a comprehensive understanding of your project’s cost implications, empowering you to make informed decisions.

4. Turnaround Time and Reliability: We prioritize delivering estimates on time, recognizing the significance of bid dates in the construction industry. Our efficient processes and dedicated team ensure that you receive your estimates promptly, allowing you to submit bids with confidence.

5. Collaboration and Communication: We believe in fostering strong partnerships with our clients. Our team actively engages with you, conducting detailed reviews of drawings, specifications, and project requirements. We also offer formal meetings to ensure a thorough understanding of your vision and objectives, aligning our estimations with your project goals.

6. Superior Quality Control: Quality control is a cornerstone of our commercial estimating services. We employ advanced cost-estimating tools and project estimation software to enhance accuracy and efficiency. Our commitment to trade consistency and rigorous cost evaluations ensures that your estimates meet the highest standards.

Our Portfolio For Commecial Construction Estimates

We take pride in our extensive commercial estimating portfolio that spans across a diverse range of industries and project types. With our team of in-house trade specialized estimators and advanced software expertise, we have delivered accurate construction estimates for projects worth multi million dollars collectively. No matter the complexity or scale, we have the knowledge and skills cto bring your vision to life.

Commercial Facilities that Exceed Expectations

From modern office buildings to captivating shopping centers, our commercial estimating services cover a wide spectrum of projects. We have successfully estimated and evaluated commercial facilities such as restaurants, retail spaces, high-rise buildings, theaters, museums, sports auditoriums, exhibition buildings, and even specialized structures like prisons, police stations, and fire stations. Whatever your commercial project entails, we have the expertise to provide precise estimates that meet your requirements.

Unleashing the Potential of Vast Construction Industry

Our portfolio extends beyond traditional commercial construction spaces. We have catered to the unique needs of various industries, including educational facilities, condominiums, airports, warehouses, parking garages, medical facilities, hotels, motels, libraries, and bus/subway facilities. With our specialized estimators and industry-specific knowledge, we ensure that each estimate is tailored to the demands of your project, guaranteeing accuracy and reliability.

Comprehensive Takeoffs for Every CSI Division

At Construct Estimates, we leave no stone unturned when it comes to commercial construction estimates. Our team of experts excels in all CSI divisions, offering comprehensive takeoffs that cover every aspect of your construction project. Whether it’s sitework, masonry, concrete, structural steel, door/windows, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, lumber, finishes, or thermal/moisture protection, we have the expertise to deliver detailed and accurate estimates.

Empowering Efficiency with Advanced Estimating Software

To enhance our estimating capabilities, we leverage the power of advanced software solutions. Our estimators are highly skilled in industry-leading software platforms such as Planswift, Bluebeam, RS Means, FastPIPE, FastDUCT, FastWRAP, IMHS Mark Systems, Xactimate, Trimble, and Quest Estimating. By harnessing these innovative tools, we streamline the estimating process, ensuring efficiency and precision in every estimate we deliver.

Home Estimating Services

Whether you’re planning a new home building construction, renovation, or room additions, our home estimating services can help. We analyze the unique requirements of your residential commercial project and provide you with detailed construction cost estimates that guide your decision-making process.

Partner with Construct Estimates for Commercial Success

When it comes to commercial estimating services, Construct Estimates stands apart as a trusted partner in turning visions into reality. Our commitment to accuracy, attention to detail, and in-depth industry knowledge sets us apart from the competition. With our comprehensive portfolio, you can rely on our expertise to bring your commercial projects to fruition.

Unlock the potential of your commercial endeavors with Construct Estimates. Contact us today to experience the difference our commercial estimating services can make for your projects.
Schedule A Call

How to Get Started with Us For Commercial Estimates

Submit Your Drawing Plans

You can easily upload your drawing plans and specifications through the Contact page or simply email us at info@constructestimates.com. We accept various formats, including PDF files, for your convenience. Whether you have a Bid set, Schematic, Design Development, Construction document, or conceptual drawings, we’ve got you covered. Don’t forget to provide us with all the necessary details by filling out the form.

Upload Plans Here!

We Review The Plans

Our team will swiftly proceed to review the intricacies of your project. We understand that every client and project is unique, which is why we take the time to analyze factors such as project range, complexity, and involved trades. This ensures complete transparency and allows you to make informed decisions.

Get A Quote

After reviewing your plans, we will promptly respond to you with a detailed quote containing essential information such as the invoice, turnaround time, and delivery date. If you find the quote acceptable, you can proceed to make the payment using your preferred method, whether it’s a credit card, debit card, or PayPal.

Receive an Estimate

Our estimators will meticulously perform takeoffs and generate an accurate estimate for your construction project. We ensure that the estimate is presented clearly and organized, allowing you to understand and evaluate the costs involved easily. You will receive the estimate in an Excel format using our template or customized to fit your specific requirements.

Streamline Your Construction Bidding Process with Virtual Bid Management

Are you tired of juggling countless tasks while trying to win construction bids? Gone are the days of manual data compilation and endless communication loops. Our Virtual Bid Manager compiles and updates subcontractor and vendor contacts. Moreover, they meticulously review project plans to shortlist the most promising projects for bidding. From managing the entire bidding process to handling addendums and change orders, our VBM ensures everything runs smoothly.

Communication is key in construction bid management, and our VBM excels at keeping everyone on the same page. With timely updates and seamless coordination, you can rest assured that all parties involved are well informed and aligned throughout the bidding journey.

Bid management can be daunting, but it’s the cornerstone of your success. Our Virtual Bid Manager offers remote assistance that transforms your bidding process. Insightful SWOT Analysis

Refined Bid Analysis

Intelligent Strategies for Winning Bids

Our Virtual Bid Manager operates remotely, giving you the flexibility to tap into their expertise precisely when you need it. No need to worry about full-time salaries or overhead costs; our VBM is ready to assist on demand.

Time-Efficient Strategies for Business Growth

Time is of the essence in the construction industry. By entrusting your bid management to our VBM, you free up valuable time to focus on other critical aspects of your business. It’s time to achieve more in less time.

Enhance Your Building Projects with Precise Interior and Exterior Finishes Estimations

When it comes to constructing remarkable buildings, accurate estimations for interior and exterior finishes are absolutely essential. From painting to stucco, and plaster to specialized coatings, these estimates play a pivotal role in securing winning bids and providing clients with accurate pricing. They serve as the foundation for ordering and procuring materials, ensuring seamless project execution.

At Construct Estimates, we understand the immense responsibility that falls on contractors when it comes to estimating costs. That’s why we prioritize experience, professionalism, and unwavering dedication to accuracy. By outsourcing your estimating needs to us, you can cut down on in-house costs while ensuring the utmost precision and reliability.

Say goodbye to financial uncertainties and embrace the assurance of precise estimates for every aspect of your project.

Save Big - Request Your 30% Off Estimate!

Why Accurate Estimating Matters

When it comes to interior and exterior finishes, such as painting, coating, drywall, and ceilings, accuracy is paramount. Contractors bear the responsibility for any shortcomings in estimates, making precision essential. By outsourcing your estimating needs to us, you can reduce in-house costs while maintaining the highest standards of accuracy and reliability.

Whether it’s metallics, patinas, chrome, or specialized coatings, accurate takeoffs, and pricing are crucial to avoid wastage and unnecessary expenses. Our team ensures that you receive precise estimates that minimize material waste and prevent financial burdens on your projects. Trust us to provide you with the exact figures you need to make informed decisions and secure profitable contracts.

Our Range of Finishes Estimating Services

Construct Estimates offer a comprehensive suite of services tailored to meet your interior and exterior finishes estimating needs. Our services include:

  • Material takeoffs: Accurate measurement and quantification of materials required for your project.
  • Flooring estimates: Detailed estimates for various types of flooring, including intricate patterns and design elements.
  • Painting estimates: Precise estimates for interior and exterior painting projects, enabling you to deliver quality bids.
  • Ceiling estimates: Thorough estimation of materials and labor costs for ceiling installations and renovations.
  • Drywall estimates: Accurate takeoffs for framing, taping, and gypsum board installations.
  • Stucco estimates: Comprehensive estimation services for stucco finishes, ensuring precise pricing and material procurement.

In addition to these core services, we also offer bid reviews, budget estimates, change order estimates, project lead generation, and subcontractor marketing. By outsourcing your finishes estimating services to us, you gain a competitive edge in the market, increase accuracy, and improve your profit margins.

Flooring Estimating & Takeoff Services

With our expertise in material takeoffs and cost estimates, we strive to be your trusted partner in delivering accurate and comprehensive flooring estimates. Our commitment to minimizing waste while considering intricate patterns, inlays, and design elements sets us apart as the go-to choice for flooring contractors, installation companies, carpet mills, architects, designers, and manufacturers.

What We Deliver To You

  • Seaming diagrams: Clear and concise diagrams that guide flooring installers in achieving flawless results, even with complex patterns and inlays.
  • Takeoff summary: A comprehensive summary that provides essential information such as total square feet, seaming and welding linear feet, wall base details, stair information, and more, ensuring nothing is overlooked.
  • Review of bid documents and addendums: Thorough analysis of bid documents and addendums to ensure accurate estimates and minimize surprises during project execution.

Electrical Estimating Services

Our team of experienced estimators is dedicated to providing accurate cost estimates for your electrical projects. With our expertise and attention to detail, we ensure that your estimates are precise, allowing you to plan and budget effectively.

At Construct Estimates, we specialize in providing exceptional Electrical Estimating Services to contractors, engineers, vendors, and homeowners. With our team of seasoned electrical estimators and industry-leading software, we deliver accurate, detailed, and customized estimates for a wide range of electrical projects. Whether you’re working on residential, commercial, or industrial ventures, our comprehensive approach ensures that we work with the latest software like ConEst, Planswift, Accubid, and Bluebeam so that your estimates are tailored to your specific needs, allowing you to plan and budget with confidence.

Uplead Plan & Get 30% Off Estimate!

Residential Electrical Estimating

For electricians and electrical traders involved in residential projects, our services offer invaluable support. We have expert estimators who provide detailed estimates for everything from improvements and additions to new homes, apartments, eco-homes, and smart homes. We cover all aspects, including power transmission lines, service panels, electric meters, wiring, switches, lighting, and more.

With our precise estimates, you can procure all the below electrical systems that can use in your residence.

  • Building Automation Systems
  • Building Management Systems
  • Home Security Systems
  • Electric Heating Systems
  • Ventilation Systems & Exhaust Fans
  • Network & Communication Systems
  • Entertainment Systems
  • Home Generator Backup Systems
  • Solar Electric Panels
  • Lighting, Switches & Controls.
  • Doorbells & Intercoms
  • Electric Receptacles

Commercial Electrical Estimates

Commercial electrical contractors face tight budgets and demanding deadlines. Our estimating services are specifically designed to ease your workload and streamline your bidding process. At Construct Estimators, we have an experienced team that is well-versed in the latest takeoff software and has a deep understanding of electrical components. Whether it’s estimating light fixtures, conduits, receptacles, or complete automation systems for large retail spaces, we have the expertise to deliver airports, Highrises, Theaters, Offices, Hotels, Hospitals, Schools, Shop fit-outs, and other electrical systems.

For commercial electrical estimating, we can do for the following systems:

  • Commercial Communications Cabling Systems

  • Emergency & Alarm systems
  • Standby Power Generating Systems
  • Access Control & Telecommunication systems
  • Computer/data processing systems
  • Low voltage distribution systems
  • Electronic door readers
  • Temperature controls
  • Solar Power Systems
  • Geothermal Systems

Industrial Electrical Estimating

Our Industrial Electrical Estimating services are the ideal solution. We have the estimators that are highly skilled in responding quickly to your needs and possess the capacity to handle diverse industrial ventures. From small factories to large plants, we have successfully provided reliable and accurate cost projections for projects in sectors such as sewerage treatment plants, wastewater treatment plants, power generation, distribution, metals, food & beverages, chemical, petrochemical, manufacturing, and mining industries.

Our industrial comprehensive estimates cover:

  • Instrumentation & Control Systems
  • Industrial Automation Systems
  • Program & Logic Control systems
  • Hazard Monitoring Systems
  • Temperature, Power & Lighting Systems
  • Power Distribution Systems
  • Wind Energy / Solar Power
  • Emergency Systems
  • Backup Generators
  • Tooling Robotics & Assembly Systems
  • Turnkey Integrated Systems
  • Motion Control Systems

We also have some of the best items that include:

  • Protection Relays and Controls
  • Fuses
  • Fuse Blocks & Accessories
  • Gas Discharge Tubes
  • Magnetic Sensors & Reed Switches
  • Polymer Suppressors
  • Resettable PTCs
  • Thyristors
  • Capacitors
  • Resistors
  • Diodes
  • Diode Arrays
  • Surge Protective
  • Devices

Low Voltage Estimating Services

Construct Estimates also offers specialized Low Voltage Estimating Services. We have the skills and experience to provide accurate estimates for a wide range of low voltage systems, including telephone, network data, audio and visual, access control, fire alarm, security sensors, CCTV surveillance, and more. Our estimators ensure that every component is accounted for, allowing you to plan and budget accordingly for your low-voltage installations.

Expert Electrical Estimators for Quick, Accurate, and Detailed Estimates

When it comes to Electrical Estimating Services, our team at Construct Estimates stands out from the crowd. They are not just competent and professional; they are the epitome of excellence. With their expertise, proficiency, and a vast array of up-to-date electrical estimating software at their fingertips, they deliver estimates that are not only quick and accurate but also incredibly detailed. By partnering with us, you gain an edge in the industry, increasing your chances of winning more bids and securing more projects.

Independent Electrical Estimators Tailored to Your Needs

As independent estimators, we are solely committed to serving your best interests with unwavering dedication. Our focus is on providing estimates that are accurate, reliable, and customized to your specific project. Our unbiased evaluations ensure that you receive estimates that enhance electrical project planning, streamline budgeting, and save valuable time and resources.

Trust us to deliver comprehensive and transparent estimates that align perfectly with your goals. Experience the advantages of having an independent electrical estimator on your side by partnering with us today.

Precise Electrical Work Cost per Square Foot

Are you in need of a reliable electrical work cost per square foot estimate to set your budget? Our highly skilled estimators are here to help. With years of experience in electrical estimation, we provide you with the most accurate and defensible per-square footage estimates for residential, commercial, and industrial projects. Our comprehensive approach includes factoring in all the necessary components, equipment, and electricians’ hourly rates based on the size, scope, and location of your project.

Electrical Design-Build CAD Drafting Services

At Construct Estimates, we go beyond estimation. We also offer top-notch CAD drafting services for electrical design-build projects. Our team of design professionals is well-versed in industry-leading software such as AutoCAD, Revit MEP, and VISIO. With their expertise, they can bring your project to life, providing complete as-built, design-build, and meticulous design assistance.

From preparing floor layouts to drafting detailed plans with specifications and sketches, our design professionals ensure every aspect is covered. We offer a full range of MEP CAD Drafting services, including mechanical piping, ducting, electrical wiring, Instrumentation, and piping layouts. Rest assured that your plans will be thoroughly quality checked and reviewed by our senior MEP Engineer, guaranteeing accuracy and precision.

How To Outsource Your Electrical Projects?

Start with Ease - Upload Your Plans

Whether you’re commercial contractor, developer, architect, or design-build firm looking for reliable electrical estimating services? We make it incredibly simple for you to get started. Just upload your plans, whether they are Schematic, Bid Set, Conceptual Design Development, or Construction Document drawings. We accept a wide range of formats, including PDF, TIFF, DXF, DWG, and more. You can even provide us with your labor rates and quoted material prices from your suppliers.

Upload Plans Here!

Get a Quick Quote that Works for You

Once you’ve uploaded your plans, we’ll send you a comprehensive quote that includes the invoice, delivery date, and turnaround time. Our flexible payment options allow you to pay conveniently via Credit Card, Debit Card, or PayPal.

Accurate and Detailed Electrical Estimates

Our team of experienced professionals is dedicated to delivering electrical estimates that meet your specific requirements. When you choose Construct Estimates, you can expect a detailed estimate that covers everything from manhours to labor and material pricing. We take pride in our accuracy and attention to detail, ensuring that you have a comprehensive understanding of the costs involved in your commercial electrical project.

Professional Bidding Proposal for Your Success

In addition to the electrical estimates, we go the extra mile to provide you with a professional bidding proposal. We understand the importance of presenting a polished and compelling bid to secure your projects. Our inclusion sheet, tailored to your project’s demands, will impress your clients and set you apart from the competition. With Construct Estimates by your side, you can approach every bidding opportunity with confidence.

Experience the Benefits of a Professional Electrical Estimating

Expert Masonry Estimating Services Tailored to Your Needs

Are you in search of the best masonry estimating services? Look no further. Construct Estimates pride ourselves on delivering top-notch and timely estimates for masonry projects across North America, Australia, and the Caribbean. With years of diversified experience in the estimation industry, we excel in providing accurate estimates that you can rely on.

Our team of expert masonry cost estimators possesses practical knowledge of masonry works and pays meticulous attention to detail. From bricks and CMU walls to clay and glass masonry, we quantify every aspect of the Division 4 masonry trade. Our comprehensive estimates cover many items, including mortar and grout, brick veneer, bond beams, lintels, insulation, flashing, masonry reinforcement, restoration, transportation, labor costs, and person hours

Get Estimate and Save 30%!

Unparalleled Accuracy with Cutting-Edge Tools and Certified Estimators

Our construction estimators utilize industry-leading software such as AccuBid, Planswift, and Bluebeam to ensure the utmost quality and precision. We adhere to the policies and guidelines of esteemed organizations like the American Association of Cost Engineers (AACE) and the Australian Institute of Quantity Surveyors (AIQS). Rest assured; your estimates will be handled by certified American and Australian estimators, guaranteeing accuracy and compliance with international standards.

Comprehensive Masonry Estimates for Various Clients

At Construct Estimates, we cater to a diverse clientele, including general contractors, masonry contractors, repair contractors, vendors, masons, developers, architects, designers, and home builders. Our services are tailored to meet each client’s specific needs, ensuring personalized and relevant estimates. Whether you require masonry takeoff services, design estimates, budget estimates, or bid submittal preparation, we’ve got you covered.

Maximize Profitability and Efficiency

Upload Plans Here!

What is Included in Our Deliverables

At Construct Estimates, we go above and beyond to provide you with a wide range of deliverables that ensure a seamless masonry estimating experience. Our commitment to excellence drives us to deliver comprehensive and detailed results that meet your specific project requirements.  When you choose our masonry estimating services, here’s what you can expect as part of our deliverables:
Accurate and Organized EXCEL Spreadsheets

Our team utilizes cutting-edge software, including Planswift and Bluebeam, to measure and quantify quantities precisely. We organize the data in easy-to-understand EXCEL spreadsheets, categorized according to the industry-standard MasterFormat. This systematic approach enables you to navigate the estimates effortlessly and make informed decisions.

Detailed Summary and Breakdown
Our deliverables provide a detailed breakdown of all essential components, including material lay rates, unit costs, labor rates, crew size, equipment, overhead, profit percentages, and more. We leave no stone unturned in capturing every aspect of your masonry project, ensuring you comprehensively understand the costs involved.
3D Wall Renderings
Visualize your masonry project like never before with our 3D wall renderings. We create multiple views that bring your vision to life, helping you better understand the outcome. These renderings allow you to make design adjustments and ensure the project meets your expectations.
Color-coded Plans
Our plans are color-coded, visually representing different elements and materials to enhance clarity and ease of interpretation.
Review of Addendums
We meticulously review any addendums or updates to the plans and specifications to ensure our estimates remain accurate and current. By staying on top of changes, we prevent potential discrepancies that could impact your project’s overall cost and timeline.
Customized Estimates
We understand that each project is unique at Construct Estimates. That’s why our deliverables can be tailored to your specific format and requirements. Whether you prefer estimates in MasterFormat or a customized layout, we adapt to your needs, providing a personalized experience.
Exceptional Quality Assurance

A senior estimator performs a comprehensive audit before delivering the final estimates. This check ensures that our deliverables maintain the highest standards of quality and accuracy, giving you the confidence to proceed with your project.

Extensive Range of Masonry Estimating Services Includes

Masonry Quantity Takeoffs
We meticulously measure and quantify all aspects of masonry works, including CMU masonry, glass unit masonry, clay unit masonry, architectural and glazed masonry, stonemasonry walls, and more.
Design Estimates
Our expert estimators provide detailed estimates based on your project’s design specifications, ensuring accurate cost projections and informed decision-making.
Bid Estimates
We prepare comprehensive estimates for bidding purposes, empowering you to present competitive proposals and increase your chances of winning projects.
Masonry Restoration Estimates
Trust our estimators to deliver precise estimates for masonry restoration projects, helping you plan and execute efficient restoration efforts.
Masonry Consulting
Need expert advice on masonry-related matters? Our knowledgeable consultants are available to guide you through challenges, offer solutions, and optimize your masonry projects.

Unlock Additional Benefits

Beyond our core services, we offer a range of additional benefits to our valued clients:

  • Value Engineering: We analyze your project’s requirements to identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality.
  • Masonry Contractor Marketing: Leverage our expertise to develop effective marketing strategies that attract more clients and increase your business’s visibility.
  • Project Lead Generation: Gain a competitive edge with our lead generation services, ensuring a consistent pipeline of potential projects.
  • Masonry Brick Wall 3D Designing Services: Visualize your masonry project beafore construction begins with our cutting-edge 3D design services, enhancing accuracy and reducing costly revisions.

The Breakdown of Our Masonry Estimation Process

Our commitment to precision is reflected in our masonry estimating spreadsheet’s comprehensive breakdown of quantities. Here’s a glimpse we consider:

Masonry Units

From concrete masonry units to bricks, CMU blocks to stone veneers, we meticulously quantify the materials required for your foundation walls, facings, partitions, and more. Our attention extends to specialized forms such as corner units, pilaster units, bond beams, and lintel blocks.

Openings and Deductions

We factor in deductions for doors, windows, and ventilation to ensure accurate measurements and optimal resource allocation.

Mortar and Grout

Determining the right amount of mortar and grout is essential for seamless masonry work. We account for different types of artillery, site conditions, and even wastages, ensuring a thorough estimation.

Reinforcement and Scaffolding

If your project requires masonry reinforcement or scaffolding, rest assured that our estimators include them in the calculations.

Miscellaneous Items

We consider the finer details, including anchor bolts, sleeves, brackets, brick ties, insulation, flashing, weep holes, and more, leaving no stone unturned.

Labor and Costs

Our estimations encompass labor costs, material costs, and equipment expenses, applying industry-standard tools like RSMeans and our extensive construction cost database. We leave no room for ambiguity, providing accurate figures tailored to your zip code-based prices.

Task-based Labor Hours

Understanding the complexity of different tasks, we estimate the person-hours and labor costs, along with additional expenses like transportation, taxes, permits, restoration, and cleaning.

Contingency Planning

We consider unforeseen costs and inflation by incorporating contingency funds, ensuring your project remains on track despite unexpected challenges.

Why Choose Our Masonry Estimating Services?

By choosing Construct Estimates as your trusted partner, you’ll unlock a world of advantages: Unmatched accuracy: Our estimators provide exact and detailed estimates, empowering you to bid confidently.

Preserving the past is as important as building for the future. Our portfolio includes estimates for masonry restoration and repair projects, ensuring that historical structures are preserved with utmost care and attention to detail.

A Seamless Journey to Get Your Masonry Estimates

MEP Estimating Services: Accurate and Reliable Cost Estimation

Are you looking for accurate and reliable MEP estimating services for your construction projects? At Construct Estimates, we specialize in providing comprehensive and cost-effective estimation solutions tailored to meet your specific needs. With our expertise in MEP cost estimating, we ensure that your projects stay within budget while maintaining high-quality standards.

With over a decade of experience in the industry, we specialize in providing affordable and precise estimating for mechanical, electrical, and plumbing projects. Our comprehensive range of services includes:

  • Fire Stopping
  • Pipe Insulation
  • Fireproofing
  • Heating
  • Moisture Protection
  • HVAC
  • Sprinklers
  • Sheet Metal
  • Spray Insulation
  • Ductwork

Prominent Features of MEP Estimating Services

Detailed Material Takeoffs for Efficient Planning

To facilitate seamless project planning, we offer material takeoff services that provide you with detailed lists of required materials. Our construction material takeoff services streamline the procurement process, saving you time and ensuring accurate material quantities for cost-effective construction.

Efficient MEP Takeoffs with Advanced Software

With our advanced MEP takeoff services and state-of-the-art estimation software, we ensure precision and efficiency in every aspect of your project. Our dedicated team utilizes industry-leading tools to generate detailed takeoff reports, allowing for quick and reliable estimation.

Professional Bidding Assistance for Competitive Advantage

In a competitive construction industry, winning bids requires expertise and accuracy. Our team provides comprehensive bidding assistance services, including accurate bid estimation and strategy development. With our support, you can enhance your bid-winning ratio and secure substantial contracts.

Professional MEP Estimates for Accurate Cost Projections

Construction estimating is a crucial aspect of any project, and our MEP cost-estimating services are designed to provide you with the precise figures you need. We understand the importance of accurate estimations in ensuring project success and avoiding costly surprises down the line.

Metal Estimating Services: Steel Takeoffs and Expert Detailing

Home

Are you grappling with the complexities of metal estimation? Construct Estimates is your dedicated partner in providing reliable, affordable, and timely metal estimating services that cater to the diverse needs of builders, fabricators, framers, distributors, and various other stakeholders in the construction industry. Our goal is to provide you with comprehensive structural steel, rebar, and miscellaneous metals estimating services that not only help you reduce overhead costs but also contribute to a greener environment by minimizing waste.

Precise and Detailed Metal Estimating Services

With years of experience, our team of expert steel estimators and engineers specializes in metal estimating and detailing, employing best practices and cutting-edge software tools to ensure precise calculations and detailed estimates. Whether it’s steel framing, rebar estimation, or complex structural steel takeoffs, our metal estimators and detailers have the technical expertise to handle projects of any size and complexity. We are committed to providing solutions that meet the highest standards of quality and professionalism.

We understand that reading technical details from plans and making accurate takeoffs can be challenging for many steel fabricators and contractors. That’s why we specialize in providing detailed and accurate steel takeoffs and estimates, ensuring that all the minute details are properly described, quantified, and proof-checked by our senior estimators. By prioritizing accuracy and attention to detail, we not only minimize waste but also ensure optimal resource utilization on the construction site.

Serving a Diverse Range of Clients

Supporting Your Metal Estimating Needs Across Industries

Our metals estimating & takeoff services serve diverse range of clients, including

  • Steel manufacturers
  • Framing contractors
  • Piping and duct fabricators
  • Sheet metal fabricators
  • Rebar and structural steel fabricators
  • Rebar and structural steel erectors
  • Installers and distributors

Whatever your role in the construction process, our team has the expertise to support you in estimating and managing the costs of your metal-related projects.

Check Steel Estimating & Detailing Samples

What's Included in Our Metal Estimating Services?

We offer a comprehensive range of services that are designed to meet your metal estimation needs.

Accurate Takeoffs and Detailed Estimates

Our metal estimating services include detailed and accurate takeoffs, covering everything from budget estimates to bid estimates. With our meticulous attention to detail, we ensure that all components, such as decks, trusses, railings, stud framing, joists, gratings, and castings, are properly described and quantified. This not only reduces waste but also contributes to a greener environment by minimizing on-site material usage.

Cost Control and Transparency

We provide comprehensive cost estimates that cover materials, labor, welders, cranes, fuel, equipment, and more. By offering a detailed breakdown of costs, we enable you to effectively plan and control your project expenses. Our estimates are delivered in an easy-to-review format, with color-coded marked-up plans that make it simple to understand and edit the estimates as needed.

Structural Steel Detailing and Shop Drawings

We offer complete structural steel detailing and shop drawing services for all types of projects. Our skilled detailers utilize advanced CAD technology to prepare precise shop drawings, placement drawings, bar bending schedules, and connection sketches that simplify the erection and installation process. These drawings provide visual clarity and help your workers execute the project more efficiently.

Bar Bending Schedules and Rebar Estimation

We specialize in providing optimized bar bending schedules for structural steel, rebar, piping, sheet metal, and HVAC duct fabrications and erections. Our rebar estimators deliver accurate and comprehensive estimates, taking into account materials, accessories, and erection costs. With our expertise, you can confidently bid on projects ranging from bridges and residential buildings to commercial complexes and industrial structures.

Change Order Management and Project Consulting

We understand that change orders can be a challenging aspect of construction projects. That’s why our team is here to assist you in effectively managing change orders, minimizing disruptions, and ensuring smooth project execution. We also offer project consulting services to help you make informed decisions, resolve conflicts, and optimize your bidding strategies.

Range of Steel Estimating Services We Provide

Precise Steel & Rebar Takeoffs for Successful Projects

At Construct Estimates, we provide a wide range of steel estimating services that serves the unique requirements of different projects.

Precise Steel Takeoffs

Our steel estimating services encompass detailed and accurate takeoffs for various types of steel materials and structures, including structural steel, rebar, steel frames, cold-form steel, and precast estimation. Our estimators ensure precise measurements and calculations based on industry standards, such as AASHTO, ASTM, CRSI, and more. Using the latest 3D modeling technology, we accurately depict the scope of work and provide detailed cost analysis and feasibility assessments.

Rebar Estimation and Detailing

Our rebar estimators are highly skilled in providing accurate estimates for rebar and reinforcing steel. We provide precise estimates for materials, accessories, and erection costs, catering to projects of any complexity, from bridges and residential buildings to commercial and industrial structures. Our detailers use advanced CAD software to create precise shop drawings, simplifying the placement of reinforcing steel and accelerating the completion of building structures.

Structural and Light Steel Detailing

With our structural and light steel detailing services, we assist structural engineers, fabricators, erectors, and installers in bringing their projects to life. Using software such as AutoCAD, Rebar CAD, ASA Microstation, and Tekla, we generate detailed shop drawings, erection drawings, and general arrangement drawings. Our attention to detail ensures accurate visualization and seamless execution of your projects.

Bar Bending Schedules and Shop/Fabrication Drawings

We provide optimized bar bending schedules that minimize wastage and maximize cost efficiency. Additionally, our shop and fabrication drawings cover various structural components, including columns, beams, braces, stairs, handrails, ladders, and more. These drawings are easy to understand, allowing for efficient fabrication and installation processes.

Compliance with Industry Standards

We pride ourselves on adhering to industry standards to ensure the highest level of quality and accuracy in our estimates and detailing services. Some of the standards we comply with include:

  • AASHTO (American Association of State Highway and Transportation Officials)
  • ASTM (American Society for Testing and Materials)
  • CRSI (Concrete Reinforcing Steel Institute)
  • RSIO (Reinforcing Steel Institute of Ontario)
  • ACI (American Concrete Institute)
  • BS (British Standard)

Software Expertise

We leverage advanced software tools and technologies to deliver precise and efficient estimating services. Our team is proficient in using software such as: 

  • Planswift
  • ASA Rebar Estimating Software
  • AutoCAD
  • Rebar CAD
  • ASA Microstation
  • RGS Rebar
  • Tekla Structures

By utilizing these tools, we enhance accuracy, streamline workflows, and deliver high-quality estimates and drawings.

Upload Plans & Minimize Your Expenses Now!

Why Choose Us For Metal Estimating?

  • Experience and Expertise: A team of skilled estimators, engineers, and detailers with extensive experience with deep understanding of materials, manufacturing processes, and industry standards enables us to deliver accurate estimates and precise shop drawings that meet the highest quality standards.
  • Fast Turnaround: We strive to deliver your estimates within 24 to 48 hours, allowing you to promptly quote prices to your clients and stay ahead of the competition.
  • Save up to 60% Expenses on Monthly Takeoffs: Monthly takeoffs package allow you to get multiple estimates at discounted rates that help you save up to 60% estimating expenses and bidding quickly to clients.
  • Cost Savings and Waste Reduction: By providing accurate estimates and detailed breakdowns of materials and costs, we help you optimize your project budget. Our emphasis on accuracy and detail minimizes wastage, reducing unnecessary material ordering and on-site storage requirements. This not only saves you money but also contributes to a more sustainable and eco-friendly construction process.
  • Dedicated Customer Support: Our team is available 24/7 to provide support through live chat and email. Whether you have questions, need assistance with editing estimates, or require project-specific advice, we are here to ensure your needs are met promptly and effectively.
  • Customizable Estimating Formats: Every project and client is unique. That’s why we offer customizable estimating formats, allowing you to organize estimates based on your preferences. Whether you prefer unit pricing, lump sum, or cost-plus formats, we can tailor the estimate deliverables to meet your specific requirements.
  • Easy Review and Editing: We make it easy for you to review and edit your estimates with color-coded marked-up plans. Our user-friendly formats allow you to make changes effortlessly, saving you time and ensuring accuracy.

Share your plans and drawings with us effortlessly. Click here to begin the process, and within minutes, our team will review your submission and define the scope of work.
