Home

Cost Estimating Services for Your Construction Projects

Empower Your Construction Projects with Accurate Cost Estimates and Achieve Success.

Request a Quote Today and Take Control of Your Project Costs.

Get Estimate With 30% Off

Construction Cost Estimating Services

Construct Estimates offers a wide range of construction cost estimating services and cost management solutions tailored to meet the unique needs of the ever-growing construction industry. With years of experience in understanding various market conditions, we empower contractors, developers, architects, and project managers to make informed decisions, control budgets, and achieve project success. Our goal is to provide reliable and tailored cost estimating services that help you streamline your bidding process, win more projects, and optimize your budget.

Our experienced construction cost estimators have successfully delivered accurate cost estimates for a wide scope of projects. We are committed to providing precise, timely, and detailed pricing information that instills confidence and drives your project forward by avoiding cost overruns.

 View Our Estimate Sample

Comprehensive Construction Cost Estimating Services

Our construction cost estimates encompass a wide range of essential components, ensuring a holistic approach to cost management throughout your project’s lifecycle. From initial feasibility studies to bid evaluation and design development to change order management, we have the expertise to support your needs. Our comprehensive services include the following:

Cost Estimates

We provide accurate and itemized cost estimates to assist contractors in bidding. These estimates enable you to bid competitively and increase your chances of winning projects. We also offer assistance with bid filings and manage your bidding network profile, ensuring a smooth and efficient bidding experience.

Material takeoffs

Our expert team accurately calculates the required quantities of construction materials, ensuring efficient procurement and cost control.

Preliminary Estimating

At the early stages of project planning, preliminary estimation help investors, developers, and owners assess the feasibility of their projects. Our estimators provide reliable and defensible preliminary estimates based on past project data, even with incomplete drawing plans. We calculate square footage costs, allowing you to analyze the viability of investing your resources wisely.

Bid evaluation and management

We assist in evaluating bids, helping you make informed decisions and select the most suitable contractors.

Design estimating

Our estimators work closely with architects and engineering firms, providing accurate estimates at every design phase to align with budgetary constraints. Our conceptual, schematic design, design development, and detailed construction cost estimating services aid in your project’s design direction.

Budget estimating and cost control

We help developers and owners establish realistic budgets, secure project financing, verify contractor bids, control costs, and optimize efficiency throughout the project.

Change order management

Our expertise in change order negotiation and review helps you mitigate risks and avoid unexpected cost escalations.

Value engineering

Our team identifies opportunities for cost savings without compromising quality, ensuring efficient utilization of resources.

Project cost management

We offer comprehensive cost management services to track project spending, control expenses, and achieve financial objectives.

If you’re searching for professional construction cost estimating companies you can rely on, look no further than Construct Estimates. We are eager to assist you in achieving your project’s goals.

Call us today at (737) 273-3314 or click the button below to upload your plans and get a quote with 30% off on your first cost estimate.

Upload Plans and Save 30% Cost

Why Choose Our Cost Estimating Services?

With years of experience in the construction industry, our team has a deep understanding of the unique challenges and dynamics of cost estimations. Our estimators undergo rigorous training and adhere to industry standards and best practices. We deliver estimates you can rely on by combining our expertise with comprehensive cost databases and zip code-based pricing.

We collaborate closely with our clients, including general contractors, subcontractors, developers, investors, architects, project managers, and homebuilders, to ensure our estimates align with project goals, timelines, and budgetary requirements.

Here’s what sets us apart as a reliable partner throughout your construction journey:

Accuracy

An accurate estimate is the foundation for successful project management. Our meticulous estimation process involves an in-depth review of design documents, an analysis of construction processes, materials, permits, and other factors that influence project costs. We leave no stone unturned to ensure the hidden costs are revealed and accounted for in our estimates.

Comprehensive Services

Our range of construction cost estimating services covers a wide scope of projects across various sectors, including:

  • Residential
  • Commercial
  • Industrial
  • Retail
  • Civil
  • Education
  • Healthcare
  • public safety
  • urban development
  • Sports and
  • entertainment
  • Parks and
  • recreation
  • mixed-use
  • development
  • Mining
  • marine projects
  • Renovations
  • Remodeling

Whatever your project entails, we have the expertise to provide accurate estimates tailored to your specific needs.

Trade-Specific Cost Estimators

Our team comprises professional estimators specializing in different trades, including site work, civil, structural, mechanical, and electrical. We also have a lead estimator who oversees all aspects of the project, ensuring a comprehensive and integrated approach to estimating. With our diverse expertise, we can deliver precise estimates for every construction discipline.

CSI Division Coverage

Construct Estimates provides construction cost estimating services in all CSI divisions. From site work to electrical, plumbing to thermal and moisture protection, our estimators are well-versed in the intricacies of each division. We ensure that no matter the nature of your project, we have the knowledge and experience to accurately estimate costs across all construction disciplines.

Accurate Cost Database

We have established strong relationships with vendors, general contractors, and subcontractors across North America. Our careful bid analysis process and business connections have helped us develop a highly accurate cost database, incorporating labor, material, and equipment costs. We also utilize industry-standard tools like RSMeans and Craftsman for precise zipped code-based pricing.

State-of-the-Art Software

To enhance the accuracy and efficiency of our estimating process, we utilize advanced technologies and construction estimating software, including:

  • Bluebeam
  • Planswift
  • FastPIPE
  • FastWRAP
  • FastDUCT
  • Xactimate
  • Trimble
    • Quest Estimating

These tools allow us to deliver the most effective and accurate estimates, aligning with your project goals and milestones.

Benefits Of Outsourcing Your Cost Estimates To Us

When you partner with Construct Estimates for your cost estimating needs, you benefit from:

  • Accurate and detailed estimates: Highly accurate and detailed cost estimates enable you to plan and budget effectively.
  • Timely turnaround: Delivers estimates within fast turnaround times (24 to 48 hours) to meet project deadlines.
  • Save up to 60% Cost Savings: Our monthly takeoff packages offer substantial savings, reducing your estimating expenses by up to 60% compared to employing a full-time estimator.
  • Expertise across various project types: Whether your project is residential, commercial, industrial, or in any other sector, Our cost estimators are certified with credible accreditations like AACE (Association for the Advancement of Cost Engineering) and AIQS (Australian Institute of Quantity Surveyors) to deliver reliable estimates.
  • Cost control measures: Our cost management services ensure your project stays within budget. We implement effective measures to control costs and mitigate risks.
  • Transparent and collaborative approach: We believe in open communication and collaboration with our clients. We keep you informed throughout the estimating process, addressing any questions or concerns you may have.

How to Get Started with Us For Cost Estimates

Submit Your Drawing Plans

You can easily upload your drawing plans and specifications through the Contact page or simply email us at info@constructestimates.com. We accept various formats, including PDF files, for your convenience. Whether you have a Bid set, Schematic, Design Development, Construction document, or conceptual drawings, we’ve got you covered. Don’t forget to provide us with all the necessary details by filling out the form.

Upload Plans Here!

We Review The Plans

Our team will swiftly proceed to review the intricacies of your project. We understand that every client and project is unique, so we take the time to analyze factors such as project range, complexity, and involved trades. This ensures complete transparency and allows you to make informed decisions.

Get A Quote

After reviewing your plans, we will promptly respond with a detailed quote containing essential information such as the invoice, turnaround time, and delivery date. If you find the quote acceptable, you can proceed to make the payment using your preferred method: a credit card, debit card, or PayPal.

Receive an Estimate

Our estimators will meticulously perform takeoffs and generate an accurate estimate for your construction project. We ensure that the estimate is presented clearly and organized, allowing you to easily understand and evaluate the costs involved. You will receive the estimate in an Excel format using our template or customized to fit your specific requirements.

At Construct Estimates, we understand the challenges faced by site work contractors, landscaping contractors, land developers, general contractors, and site contractors. Transform Your Construction Workflow

They are well-versed in handling public, commercial, and residential projects. With our expertise, you can trust that your excavation estimating needs are in capable hands.

Elevate Your Construction Projects

Earthwork Estimating Services: The Foundation of Your Project

Excavators, site engineers, and specialized contractors require reliable earthwork estimating services to gauge the total cost of land preparation before commencing construction. Construct Estimates provides quick and accurate earthwork volumes, bid preparations, and materials takeoffs using Bluebeam, Civil 3D, and Planswift, enabling you to meet critical deadlines and make informed decisions. Our experienced team ensures that every aspect, from high and low elevation points to ridge, swale, breaking, hook, wall top/bottom, and pad elevation, is accounted for in your earthwork estimate.

A comprehensive report detailing site excavation requirements.

Accurate calculations of cut and fill quantities.

Export or Import Quantities

Whether you’re a landscaping contractor, developer, or architect, our skilled estimators can provide accurate cost analysis, material takeoffs, and comprehensive estimates to set profitable margins and boost your business.

Our landscaping estimating services cover various elements, from estimating hardscape and softscape to sprinkler system installation and irrigation water budget plans. With advanced software tools such as Planswift and AutoCAD, our expert estimators perform on-screen takeoffs, ensuring precise measurements and detailed material takeoff lists that are easy to read and send to your local vendors for pricing.

Whether you’re working on a golf course construction project or a sports complex development, we have the experience and expertise to deliver exceptional landscaping estimates. Our construction cost consultants specialize in specific trades, including fences, gates, retaining walls, fabricated bridges, and playground surfaces. We provide detailed estimates that account for each line item and establish accurate profit margins. Whether ordering materials, creating project budgets, or assessing project feasibility, our site improvement takeoffs give you the information you need to make informed decisions and secure profitable contracts.

Thermal & Moisture Protection Estimating Services

Home

Estimating Services That Shield Your Project with Precision

Protecting your residential or commercial property from the damaging effects of thermal and moisture elements is of paramount importance. At Construct Estimates, we understand the significance of comprehensive thermal and moisture protection estimating services to ensure the longevity and integrity of your building. Our team of experienced estimators is dedicated to providing you with accurate cost estimates tailored to your specific needs, enabling you to make informed decisions and take proactive measures against potential risks.

Supercharge Your Success

Experience Accurate and Efficient Thermal Moisture Protection Estimating Services

Are you in need of reliable thermal moisture estimating services? Look no further! We specialize in providing top-notch solutions for residential and commercial properties, as well as a wide range of industries. From homes and apartments to hospitals and chemical industries, our skilled team of estimators will ensure that you receive accurate and comprehensive assessments.

Residential Services

Trust our expertise in thermal moisture estimation for residential properties, including homes, apartments, studio flats, condominiums, townhouses, and more. Whether you’re planning home additions, improvements, renovations, or remodeling projects, our estimators will deliver reliable results.

Commercial Services

For commercial facilities such as arenas, schools, hospitals, shopping malls, multi-family properties, offices, hotels, and restaurants, we offer precise thermal moisture estimating services. Our thorough assessments will help you make informed decisions and protect your valuable investments.

Industrial Services

We understand the unique requirements of industrial settings. Our thermal moisture estimators are skilled in providing accurate assessments for petrochemical facilities, mining, and metals operations, marine structures, drilling projects, dams, pharmaceutical plants, highways, bridges, chemical industries, and water treatment plants. Rely on our expertise to safeguard your industrial infrastructure.

Save Big - Request Your 50% Off Estimate!

Expertise in a Wide Range of Protective Measures

Our thorough knowledge and hands-on experience in the field of thermal and moisture protection make us the trusted choice for all your estimation requirements. Whether you require waterproofing, roofing, fire-stopping, caulking, siding, sealants, roof consulting, sheet metal flashing, or trim contractors, our estimators have served these trades for numerous years, delivering reliable estimates ranging from sealants and vapor barriers to insulation.

Streamlined Material Takeoff for Waterproofing & Damp Proofing

Our expertise extends beyond roofing. Waterproofing and dampproofing contractors rely on our services for accurate material takeoffs that not only form the basis of their bids to general contractors but also facilitate efficient material procurement. 

We provide detailed guidance on the application of necessary materials, whether it be on foundations, footings, or below-grade slabs. Additionally, air vapor barriers and sealants contractors benefit from our services by obtaining precise information on the required material quantities for their projects.

Thorough Fire Proofing & Fire Stopping Estimations

When it comes to fireproofing and fire stopping, attention to detail is crucial. Our estimators excel in providing detailed descriptions and takeoffs of plans, including fireproofing ratings and structural assemblies such as beams, columns, walls, and framing. We ensure that the thickness and material of insulation, as well as the structural details of the assembly, are accurately captured.  Contractors can rely on our expertise to develop comprehensive bids and make informed procurement decisions. Our portfolio includes successful projects across schools, public facilities, hospitals, commercial zones, retail, and restaurants.

Enhance Your Building with Exceptional Thermal and Moisture Protection Services

Our expertise extends to intumescent fireproofing, siding panels, reflective insulation, weather barriers, coping, fascias, and much more. With meticulous attention to detail, we provide accurate takeoffs for every aspect of your project.

Safeguard your construction against vapor transmission, optimizing energy efficiency and protecting against mold and mildew.

Reflective Insulation Takeoffs
Enhance energy efficiency and create a comfortable indoor environment with our reflective insulation takeoffs.
Weather Barriers Takeoffs
Safeguard your building against harsh weather conditions by implementing weather barriers based on our meticulous takeoffs.
Coping Takeoffs
Protect the edges of your building from water infiltration with our detailed takeoffs for coping installation.
Fascias Takeoffs
Enhance the architectural appeal of your construction while providing functional protection with accurately measured fascias takeoffs.
Bituminous Roofing Takeoffs
Ensure a robust and watertight roofing system with our precise takeoffs for bituminous roofing materials.
Spray Fireproofing Takeoffs
Meet fire safety regulations by obtaining accurate takeoffs for spray fireproofing and safeguarding your project.
Smoke Barriers Takeoffs

Effectively contain smoke and control its spread with our meticulous takeoffs for smoke barrier installation.

Plastic Insulation Takeoffs
Enhance energy efficiency and thermal performance by accurately measuring plastic insulation takeoffs.
Pipe Flashing System Takeoffs
Prevent leaks and water damage around pipes with our comprehensive takeoffs for pipe flashing systems.
Vinyl Siding Takeoffs

EIFS (Exterior Insulation and Finish Systems) Takeoffs

Optimize energy efficiency and aesthetics by obtaining precise takeoffs for EIFS installation.

Flashings Takeoffs
Safeguard vulnerable areas of your building from water infiltration with our comprehensive takeoffs for flashings.
Fiber Insulation Takeoffs
Achieve optimal thermal efficiency with our precise takeoffs for fiber insulation installation

Ready to Take the Next Step?

Roofing contractors regard us as the best roofing estimates company, and for good reason. We value our partnership with contractors and prioritize delivering estimates that meet their specific requirements. Our dedicated team forwards all relevant details to the relevant departments, ensuring that necessary considerations are taken into account. The result is a comprehensive, easy-to-comprehend, and meaningful roof estimate that supports your bidding process and procurement decisions. With our 24/7 support, we are always available to address any queries or concerns.

You can trust that our services meet the highest industry standards.

Ready to streamline your construction project and achieve greater success? Contact us today at (737) 273-3314 or email us info@constructestimates.com to explore how our expert estimators and consultants can assist you in reaching your goals.

Comprehensive Estimating Consulting Services

Construct Estimates offer a range of specialized services to cater to the unique needs of contractors, developers, homeowners, and other industry professionals:

Bidding Assistance

We create accurate bills of material and bids, provide bid filing advice, and develop strategies for winning and negotiating assignments. We also assist in maintaining our customers' bidding network profiles, contributing to their success.

Feasibility Studies

As a developer, investor, or business owner, you may have doubts about the viability of your next project. Our preliminary estimates, feasibility studies, and square footage pricing provide valuable insights for decision-making from economic, legal, scheduling, and financial standpoints.

Litigation Assistance

If you find yourself embroiled in a construction-related legal dispute involving incompetence, misrepresentation, or fraud, our estimating consultants can provide valuable assistance. We employ reliable cost data to help resolve disagreements between contractors, vendors, designers, and owners. Our unbiased and objective estimates, stamped by our firm, can be used to support intervention, negotiation, testimony, and trials.

Pre-construction & Change Order Management

Precise material takeoff, labor estimation, and person-hours are crucial when planning a construction project. Project Cost Management

CPM Scheduling Services

Vendors

Accurate Cost Estimates and Budget Control for Your Industrial Projects

Enhance Your Industrial Projects with Accurate Estimating Services, Procurement Assistance, and Budget Control at Competitive Prices

Supercharge Your Estimates

Get Started Today & Save 30%

Specialized Industrial Construction Estimating Services

Are you in need of professional industrial estimating services that can save you money and improve the accuracy of your estimates? We offer comprehensive quantity takeoffs, cost estimates, and analysis services to clients in the American and Australian industrial sector to ensure the success of your industrial projects.

Whether you are involved in new construction, renovations, or remodeling projects, our team has the expertise to meet your specific needs. From structural steel estimation to electrical system components, our estimators possess in-depth knowledge and utilize advanced techniques to deliver precise estimates for your industrial construction projects.

With our professional estimators and advanced cost management techniques, we help you anticipate, plan, achieve efficient budget control, and make informed decisions throughout the project lifecycle.

Precise Cost Estimates for Effective Project Planning

Industrial estimates are critical in project planning, resource allocation, and decision-making. Our licensed team of industrial estimators meticulously analyzes project requirements, specifications, and drawings to determine the quantities of materials needed. By calculating the associated costs, including material costs, labor costs, equipment costs, and indirect expenses, we provide you with accurate cost estimates that serve as a solid foundation for effective project planning and budget control.

Upload Plans Now!

Our Range Of Industrial Project Estimation Services

Comprehensive Quantity Estimation and Material Takeoff

We offer comprehensive quantity estimation and material takeoff solutions to ensure the precise allocation of resources for all divisions of your industrial project. Whether it’s site work, foundation, structural steel, mechanical services, electrical services, process piping, insulation, HVAC systems, Hydronic systems, Fireproofing, Welding, painting, or coating, Our skilled estimators identify and quantify the various materials, equipment, and labor required for your industrial projects.

Through detailed quantity take-offs and material takeoff reports, we provide an in-depth understanding of the quantities and costs involved, facilitating efficient procurement, scheduling, and project planning.

Bid Evaluation and Management

Our bid evaluation and management services help you make informed decisions when selecting contractors and suppliers for your project. We analyze bids, assess contractor qualifications, and provide recommendations based on our expertise and industry knowledge.

Procurement Assistance for Competitive Prices and Quality Resources

Our procurement assistance services are designed to help you source materials and equipment at competitive prices without compromising quality. Leveraging our extensive industry network and expertise, we assist you in sourcing materials and labor at competitive prices, ensuring you have access to the best resources within your budget constraints. With our support, you can optimize your procurement process and secure the materials and services necessary for successful project execution.

Risk Analysis and Feasibility Studies

Managing risk is crucial for the success of any industrial project. Our team conducts thorough risk analyses and feasibility studies to identify potential challenges and evaluate project viability. This information allows you to make informed decisions and mitigate risks effectively.

Project Scheduling and Cost Management

Effective project scheduling and cost management are essential for timely and cost-efficient completion. Our cost management solutions empower you to monitor and control project costs throughout the construction process. We assist you in developing project schedules, optimizing resource allocation, and implementing cost-control measures to ensure your project stays on track and within budget.

Value Engineering and Quality Assurance

Construct Estimates focus on finding innovative ways to reduce costs while maintaining or improving the quality of your project. We also provide quality assurance and quality control estimates to ensure your project meets the highest standards and specifications.

Software Proficiency and Deliverables

We utilize the latest software tools to enhance our estimating capabilities. Our software proficiency includes Bluebeam, Planswift, Trimble, FastPIPE, FastDUCT, RSMeans, and more. These advanced tools help us provide accurate estimates and deliverables within 24 to 48 hours.

Why Choose Our Industrial Construction Estimates?

Construct Estimates understand the importance of accurate cost estimates and their impact on your project’s success. Here’s why you should choose our industrial estimating services.

Accuracy and Efficiency

Our estimates facilitate effective budget management and loan acquisition by obtaining a clear picture of your project’s costs at the early stages. You can plan your financial resources more effectively, secure necessary funds, and stay on track.

Customized Solutions

We recognize that each client has unique needs and requirements. That’s why our industrial estimating services are tailored to meet the specific demands of your project. Whether you’re in the chemical, petrochemical, mining, marine, or any other industry, our wide range of services can be customized to fit your project’s scope and specifications.

Extensive Portfolio Covering Multiple Industries

Over the years, we have successfully provided cost estimates for various industrial projects, from maintenance and repair tasks to multi-million-dollar construction endeavors. Our portfolio includes industries such as:

  • Pharmaceutical plants
  • Chemical
  • Petrochemical
  • Oil & Gas
  • Drilling Platforms
  • Food Processing
  • Hydrocarbon Processing
  • Wastewater Plants
  • Bio-fuels
  • Refinery
  • Polymers
  • Fertilizers
  • Packaging
  • Refrigeration
  • Pumping Stations

Specialized Expertise

Our team of estimators and engineers excels when it comes to specialized areas like industrial structural steel estimating, electrical systems, or mechanical estimation. We have successfully catered to structural steel contractors, design firms, electrical contractors, mechanical contractors, and more. With our specialized expertise, we can provide you with detailed quantity takeoffs, cost estimates, and procurement services specific to your industry.

Transforming Projects into Success Stories

Build with Confidence – Uncover the True Costs of Your Construction Project with Precise Preliminary Estimates!

Are you tired of grappling with incomplete drawing plans and struggling to prepare accurate estimates? This uncertainty makes it challenging to prepare accurate estimates and can hinder your progress.

What is a Preliminary Cost Estimate and Why Does It Matter?

Gain Valuable Insights with Conceptual Estimates and Project Feasibility

A Preliminary estimate is an approximate cost calculated during the conceptual stage of a project. It helps stakeholders like builders, owners, contractors, and real estate developers get a general idea of how much the project will likely cost. Preliminary or conceptual estimates are commonly used in construction project management and financial planning to provide an early understanding of the potential costs, resources, or outcomes associated with a particular endeavor.

Since the project drawings and specifications are still in their early stages, the preliminary estimate is an initial assessment based on limited information. It allows for early decision-making and helps determine the feasibility and viability of the project.

Types of Preliminary Estimates for Different Project Stages

There are several methods and tools available to calculate a preliminary estimate. These may include using historical data from similar projects, applying unit rates, utilizing cost databases, or employing conceptual estimating software. By inputting relevant parameters and data, such as project size, scope, materials, labor, and overhead costs, we can generate a preliminary cost estimate to guide your planning and decision-making processes. We tailor our approach to match the extent of available information and deliver assessments with the desired accuracy.

Rough Order Magnitude (ROM) Estimate: At the early stages of your project, our ROM estimates provide a broad range of costs, allowing you to analyze the feasibility and make high-level decisions. With an accuracy range of -50% to +50%, these estimates serve as a valuable starting point.

Ballpark Estimate: When you need to define the project’s scope within your client’s budget, Ballpark estimates come into play. Based on preliminary drawings and specifications, these estimates offer a closer approximation with an accuracy range of around 20% of the actual cost.

Budget Estimate: As your project progresses into the planning stage, our budget estimates utilize past project data and plans to provide detailed cost breakdowns. With an accuracy range of -10% to +25%, these estimates assist in allocating funds and establishing cost limits.

Definitive Estimate: When your project reaches the advanced planning phase, our definitive estimates offer detailed itemized lists of the components involved. Utilizing thoroughly developed project plans, these estimates provide enhanced accuracy, typically falling within a range of -5% to +15%.

Empowering Informed Decision-Making and Financial Planning

Our preliminary cost estimates offer a range of benefits that enable you to navigate construction planning with confidence:

Effective Budget Management and Loan Acquisition

Our estimates facilitate effective budget management and loan acquisition by obtaining a clear picture of your project’s costs at the early stages. You can plan your financial resources more effectively, secure necessary funds, and stay on track.

Setting Project Cost Limits for Architects and Designers

Our preliminary estimates help you establish realistic cost limits for architects and designers, enabling them to align their plans with your budgetary constraints from the outset. This ensures that design proposals are feasible and cost-effective.

Probable Material and Labor Costs

With our estimates, you gain valuable insights into probable material and labor costs. This empowers you to plan and negotiate with suppliers and contractors more effectively, optimizing resource allocation and ensuring cost-efficient operations.

Strategic Project Planning

Our estimates provide a solid foundation for project planning. By understanding the projected costs early on, you can make strategic decisions regarding project scope, timelines, and resource allocation, setting the stage for successful execution.

Collaboration and Negotiation Support

Our preliminary estimates facilitate collaboration and negotiation with contractors and subcontractors. With a detailed breakdown of quantities and costs, you can engage in meaningful discussions and negotiations, ensuring a transparent and efficient project partnership.

Easy-to-Understand Conceptual Estimates for Your Clients

At Construct Estimates, we understand that effective communication with prospective clients is crucial when quoting preliminary estimates. We have developed a client-friendly approach that ensures clarity and transparency throughout the estimation process. Here’s how we quote conceptual cost estimates to help you build trust and foster strong client relationships:

Simplified Floor Area-Based Estimates

Our preliminary cost estimates are based on the floor area, a universally recognized metric in the construction industry. That’s what makes it easy for your clients and architects to understand and interpret the information. By using this approach, we simplify the estimation process, making it easier for your clients to grasp the overall project costs and assess its feasibility.

Providing a Comprehensive Bill of Material

Our estimates include a comprehensive bill of materials covering all the construction project’s essential components. Here’s what you can expect in our preliminary estimates:

  • Total area (square foot or square meter) of the complete project: We calculate the overall area to determine the scale of the project and provide an accurate estimate.
  • Linear measurement (foot or meter) of each structure, such as walls: We take into account the linear measurements of key structures to accurately estimate materials and labor.
  • Area of each unit, including rooms and floors: We break down the project into individual units to provide a detailed estimate of the specific areas involved.

Preliminary Estimating Components: A Comprehensive Breakdown

We believe in leaving no stone unturned when delivering transparent and detailed estimates. Here’s what you can expect in our preliminary estimate breakdown:

1.  Preliminaries: These include initial activities and costs involved in project setup, such as site preparation, temporary facilities, and permits.

2. Substructures: This division covers critical elements like footings, foundations, and other supporting structures that form the building’s base. We calculate the quantities and costs of materials and labor involved in this critical component.

3. Superstructures: Superstructures include elements such as brickwork, walls, sidings, roofs, staircases, floors, doors, and windows. Our estimates break down the quantities and costs associated with each component, ensuring a comprehensive understanding of the project’s construction elements.

4. External and internal finishes: This component accounts for the finishing touches that contribute to the aesthetics and functionality of the building. It includes flooring, drywall, painting, and other interior and exterior finishes.

5. Fittings: Fittings encompass the installation of fixtures, fittings, and equipment necessary for the functionality of the building. We include the costs of plumbing fixtures, lighting fixtures, electrical switches, and other fittings relevant to the project.

6. Mechanical: This component covers HVAC systems, ductwork, and other mechanical systems required for climate control and ventilation. Our estimates consider the equipment, materials, and labor costs associated with this aspect of the project.

7. Plumbing: Plumbing involves the installation of pipes, drains, fixtures, and other plumbing elements. We provide a breakdown of the quantities and costs associated with plumbing, ensuring an accurate estimation of this essential component.

8. Electrical: The electrical aspect of any construction project is crucial. Our estimates include the cost of cables, conduits, lighting, and other electrical components, providing a comprehensive breakdown of these expenses.

9. Labor and Man Hours: We understand that labor costs are a significant factor in any project. Our estimates outline the labor requirements and provide an estimation of man-hours, giving you a clear understanding of the human resources needed for successful project execution.

10. Contingency: Unforeseen circumstances can impact a project’s cost. Our estimates incorporate a contingency component to account for unexpected events or changes that may arise during construction. This ensures that you are prepared for any unforeseen expenses.

11. Project Schedule: Timing is crucial in construction projects. We provide a preliminary project schedule estimate, allowing you to plan and allocate resources effectively.

What You Get with Our Preliminary Cost Estimate

Our preliminary cost estimate services cover a wide range of aspects crucial to your project’s success. Here’s a glimpse of what we offer:

Early-Stage Estimates: We understand the importance of having a general idea of costs early on. Our preliminary estimates provide you with a solid foundation for your project planning and budgeting, giving you a head start in making informed decisions.

Accurate Calculations: We go beyond rough approximations. Our team combines meticulous analysis, advanced software tools, and industry expertise to deliver accurate calculations that you can rely on with confidence.

Data-Driven Approach: Our estimators are skilled at working with limited information. We leverage our vast database, industry benchmarks, and access to reliable sources to fill in the gaps and ensure our estimates are as precise as possible.

Risk Mitigation: Construction projects are often prone to unforeseen challenges. Our preliminary estimates help you identify potential risks and uncertainties early on, empowering you to proactively plan and mitigate them, saving you time and money in the long run.

Collaborative Process: We believe in fostering open communication and collaboration throughout the estimation process. Our team works closely with you, ensuring that your inputs, feedback, and specific data are incorporated into the estimate, resulting in a customized solution that meets your needs.

Your Success Begins with a Precise Preliminary Estimate

At Construct Estimates, we understand the criticality of a precise preliminary estimate in construction planning. Our team of experts, backed by years of industry experience, delivers reliable forecasts tailored to your specific project requirements. Whether you need conceptual estimates, budget estimates, or definitive estimates, we have you covered. Make informed decisions, manage your budget effectively, and embark on your construction journey with confidence. Contact us today at info@constructestimates.com or (737) 273-3314 to discuss your project needs and take advantage of our comprehensive preliminary estimate services.

Supercharge Your Bids - Save 30% Today!

How to Begin Your Preliminary Estimates with Us

Submit Your Drawing Plans

You can easily upload your drawing plans and specifications through the Contact page or simply email us at info@constructestimates.com. We accept various formats, including PDF files, for your convenience. Whether you have a Bid set, Schematic, Design Development, Construction document, or conceptual drawings, we’ve got you covered. Don’t forget to provide us with all the necessary details by filling out the form.

Upload Plans Here!

We Review The Plans

Our team will swiftly proceed to review the intricacies of your project. We understand that every client and project is unique, which is why we take the time to analyze factors such as project range, complexity, and involved trades. This ensures complete transparency and allows you to make informed decisions.

Get A Quote

After reviewing your plans, we will promptly respond to you with a detailed quote containing essential information such as the invoice, turnaround time, and delivery date. If you find the quote acceptable, you can proceed to make the payment using your preferred method, whether it’s a credit card, debit card, or PayPal.

Receive an Estimate

Our estimators will meticulously perform takeoffs and generate an accurate estimate for your construction project. We ensure that the estimate is presented clearly and organized, allowing you to understand and evaluate the costs involved easily. You will receive the estimate in an Excel format using our template or customized to fit your specific requirements

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does it cost to get an estimate from Construct Estimates?

At Construct Estimates, we understand that every project is unique, and our pricing is tailored accordingly. To get a personalized quote for your project, simply send your plans to info@constructestimates.com. For smaller projects that require a few hours to get estimates, we charge $50. Mid-sized projects fall in the $199 to $500 range, while larger projects are usually $800 or more.

Where do you get your prices from?

Our pricing comes from the reliable Craftsman National Construction Estimator Database Suite. This database is updated frequently throughout the year, allowing us to stay current with market fluctuations and labor and material costs. By basing our estimates on your project’s zip code, we ensure that your bids are accurate and competitive.

What is the typical turnaround or delivery time for estimates?

For most projects, our delivery time is between 24 – 28 hours. Occasionally, larger or more complex projects may take 4-5 business days. We always provide you with an estimated timeframe before starting.

Do you offer hourly services, or are there monthly packages available?

While we primarily offer monthly packages, we understand that different clients have unique requirements. So, we are open to creating customized hourly packages to suit your needs. Feel free to share the details of your project, and our experts will propose the most suitable package for you.

For an overview of our standard and customized package options, please visit our Pricing to find the plan that best aligns with your project’s needs and goals.

Do you offer monthly packages and long-term relationships?

Yes, we believe in building long-term relationships with our clients and offer monthly estimation packages. This approach is ideal for busy contractors as these packages are designed to save you up to 60% on estimation expenses compared to hiring an in-house estimator. Our rates are designed to be affordable and efficient, allowing you to focus on your projects without worrying about estimating costs. Our commitment to providing value and top-notch service extends throughout our partnership.

Are there any binding agreements for monthly packages?

Our monthly packages are designed to be flexible and without any binding agreements. We don’t enforce credit card deductions on a monthly basis automatically. You have complete control over the duration and continuation of our services, ensuring that you receive the assistance you need on your terms.

Can I see examples of your estimates?

Of course! Visit our featured projects to see real examples of estimates we’ve prepared for our clients. From developers and general contractors to subcontractors, architects, and various types of projects like residential, drywall and framing, painting, and more, you’ll find a diverse range of examples to help you gauge the quality of our work.

How do I acquire the bill for my project?

To get started with our estimating services, simply upload your plans and project details to our website. Once we review your project, we’ll provide you with a quote and proposed turnaround time. After accepting the quote, we’ll send you an invoice, and upon payment, we’ll commence work on your project.

What types of projects and estimates do you specialize in?

At Construct Estimates, we are experts in various types of projects, including Commercial, Residential, and Industrial. Our range of estimates covers everything from Remodeling, New Construction, High Rises, Multifamily, and Restaurants, to Mixed-Use Retail and Residential, Warehouses, and more. We provide estimates for General Contractors, Subcontractors, Developers, Architects, Owners, Lenders/Banks, Appraisers, Insurance Companies, and many other stakeholders.

What if I don't have detailed plans for my project?

No worries! We understand that plans might not always be available. At Construct Estimates, we can still help you estimate the costs of your project based on the quantities you provide or even rough sketches. Our experienced team will use their expertise to create preliminary estimates to guide you in making informed decisions.

Can I get an estimate even if my drawings are not complete?

Absolutely! We frequently collaborate with Architects, Developers, and Owners during the early planning and design stages. If you have preliminary drawings, specifications or an idea of what you’d like to build, our team of estimators can provide accurate estimates for construction costs. This way, you can plan your project’s budget and design decisions accordingly.

How do I send you the plans for the project?

Sending us your plans is quick and easy. You have several options to choose from:

Email the plans and trades you want to bid to info@constructestimates.com.

Or Upload the plans Here.

What CSI trades does Construct Estimates cover?

 Construct Estimates offers comprehensive estimating services, covering all CSI divisions and trades of construction. From Civil, Structural, Drywall, Framing, Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, Roofing, Flooring, to Structural & Misc. Steel, Thermal and moisture protection, Fire suppression, Sitework, and Lumber takeoffs, we ensure accurate and detailed estimates for your specific project needs.

How do you ensure the accuracy of material takeoffs estimation?

To ensure the highest level of accuracy, Construct Estimates utilizes advanced softwares such as PlanSwift, PlanDuct, and Bluebeam for quantifying material takeoffs. These tools, coupled with our estimators’ expertise, allow us to provide precise measurements and quantities for your construction projects, enabling you to craft the most accurate budget.

Do you provide consultancy services to help me win bids and be more competitive?

Absolutely! Our team of estimators, comprising skilled engineers, trade specialists, field superintendents, and project managers, is more than happy to provide valuable consultancy services. We aim to empower our clients with the knowledge and strategies needed to enhance their competitiveness, win more bids, and succeed in the construction industry.

Can I get suggestions and plans from Construct Estimates for my project?

Yes, definitely! Our experienced team of professionals, including architects, developers, and designers, is well-equipped to provide you with expert suggestions and plans for your construction project. Even if you don’t have detailed plans, we can help you visualize and craft a roadmap to turn your dream construction into reality.

How does Construct Estimates protect my personal and project information?

At Construct Estimates, we prioritize the protection of your personal and project-related information. Any information you provide, including name, email address, and contact number, is solely used to provide you with the best service and negotiate on our quotes. We do not engage in unsolicited calls or emails and ensure that your data remains confidential and secure.

Do you disclose client information to third parties?

Absolutely not! Construct Estimates is committed to maintaining the highest ethical standards and safeguarding the privacy of our clients. We do not disclose, share, or have any links with third parties that would require or request our clients’ information. Your information is safe with us, and we strictly adhere to this policy.

How does Construct Estimates comply with privacy laws like CalOPPA, COPPA, and CANSPAM Act?

At Construct Estimates, we ensure full compliance with privacy laws like the California Online Privacy Protection Act (CalOPPA), the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA), and the Controlling the Assault of Non-Solicited Pornography And Marketing (CANSPAM) Act. We have a published privacy policy on our website, ensuring transparency about the data we collect and how it is used. Your privacy is of utmost importance to us, and we respect your rights.

What are the fair information practices implemented by Construct Estimates?

Construct Estimates follows fair information practices that revolve around transparency and ethical handling of your information. We never breach personal, commercial, or bid information between stakeholders, and it is strictly prohibited. You can rest assured that your information remains secure and is used solely for the purpose of providing you with the best customer service.

How do I get started with Construct Estimates' construction estimating services?

Getting started with Construct Estimates is simple. Just send us your plans and project details and specifications to info@constructestimates.com. Once we receive your submission, our estimators will review the information and provide you with a quote, along with the proposed turnaround time. After accepting the quote, we’ll send you an invoice for payment, and upon payment, we’ll start working on your project and deliver the estimate within the agreed timeframe

How much does it cost for a material takeoff or an estimate?

The cost of a material takeoff or estimate varies depending on the scope and size of your project. We review the drawings/plans and scope of work before providing a quote. You can upload your plans on our website, and we’ll promptly review and quote you. We believe in negotiable quotes and encourage you to share your plans with us for accurate pricing.

Do you charge separately for amendments, changes in drawings, and filing bids?

At Construct Estimates, we value our clients’ satisfaction and strive to provide exceptional service. We do not charge for minor revisions or changes in drawings. For significant addendums, we may apply a nominal charge. Additionally, separate charges may apply for filing bids. However, we maintain transparency in our pricing, and you can always discuss any concerns with us

How can I trust that Construct Estimates will deliver the best estimating services for my project?

At Construct Estimates, we take pride in our team’s expertise and experience. Our estimators are certified by reputable organizations like the American Association of Cost Engineers (AACE) and the Australian Institute of Quantity Surveyors (AIQS). We adhere to international standards and continuously update our knowledge to provide the best estimating services for your project. With Construct Estimates, you can trust that your project is in capable hands.

Home

Residential Estimating Services for Your Construction Projects

Empower Your Residential Building Projects with Affordable Cost Estimation and Material Takeoff Solutions with Fast Turnaround Time.

Save Upto 30% On Estimating Expenses

Accurate Estimates for Residential Construction Projects

With our expertise in residential construction estimating and architectural assessments, we strive to provide comprehensive solutions tailored to your specific needs. Whether you’re a Homeowner, Architect, Contractor, or Builder, Lenders, and Investors, our team of professional estimators is here to assist you in achieving your project goals efficiently and cost-effectively.

 View Our Sample Estimates

Our Residential Estimating Portfolio: Unveiling the Essence of Your Dream Home

At Construct Estimates, we take pride in our track record of successful projects with satisfied clients. We have provided comprehensive estimates for diverse residential endeavors, including general contractors, developers, and notable projects. With our expertise and attention to detail, we ensure accurate and reliable quantity takeoffs tailored to your specific needs.

Our expertise extends to various aspects of construction, including Sitework, concrete, Plumbing Fixtures, Electrical and Mechanical Installations, drywall and framing, paint and wallcovering, Labor Costs and Man-Hours, and much more.

Accurate and Efficient Material Quantification
